gates.parameters: Any V with Quiver V, fixed root:V, p q:PathUnfolding.Occurrence root. No finite/countable/thin/acyclic/decidable-equality assumption.
gates.candidate_exact_statement: Quiver.Reachable p q ↔ List.IsPrefix (EdgeTrace.encode root p.history) (EdgeTrace.encode root q.history)
gates.statement_syntax: Mathematical/Lean-shaped target only; not elaborated or checked. Reachable is existing Nonempty(Quiver.Path p q).
required_proof_work: Forward direction: use the actual unfolding path, ofPath_comp_projection, and encodePath_comp to express q trace as p trace appended with the projected suffix trace.
Reverse direction: obtain an actual suffix list from List.IsPrefix; use validity of the q trace, validFrom_append_iff, and finish_encodePath to prove this suffix valid from p.endpoint.
Use existing proof-indexed EdgeTrace.decode at p.endpoint, existing unique_finite_lift from p, and encode_injective at the fixed original root to prove the lifted endpoint is the exact q occurrence.
Preserve source/target/actual-arrow tags, chronological append order and repeated positions. An endpoint equality or mere base Reachable proof cannot substitute for full-history equality.
State exact equivalence for occurrence ancestry; do not claim an arbitrary base DAG embeds in a single prefix tree, or that reachability gives proof implication or permission.
required_controls: Actual empty occurrence/reflexive prefix and a concrete two-edge lifted prefix chain.
Two distinct Bool parallel-loop length1 occurrences have equal base endpoint and vertex sequence but incomparable full tagged traces and no occurrence path between them.

Actual base loop/revisit permits endpoint/base reachability while a selected occurrence relation still fails; prove that precise obstruction in accepted positive control code before testing intended negative consumer.

Negative consumer must reject substitution of projected base reachability or endpoint equality for the exact occurrence/prefix obligation; bind the sole intended diagnostic and complete named control proof census.
limits: No JSON/list parser runtime refinement, serialization certificate or whole-cache taxonomy implication.
Explicit noncomputable mathematical definitions where needed; no generated partial-helper exemption.

gates.parameters: Fixed root in arbitrary Quiver; reachable vertex subtype R={v:V // Quiver.Reachable root v}.
candidate_exact_contract: Construct the actual map e:Occurrence root→R from node.endpoint and node.path.reachable.
Choose a noncomputable section s:R→Occurrence root using a supplied reachable path witness via classical choice; prove e(s(v))=v, hence e∘s=id_R and s injective.
Retraction terminology: e is a retraction of s. Do not reverse the identity: s∘e=id_Occurrence generally fails.
Use existing endpoint_range_iff as an actual existence supplier, not an assumed new global surjectivity hypothesis. Full base V coverage still requires every vertex reachable.
required_proof_work: Expose the exact chosen-path witness and both maps; prove the actual right-inverse identity, rather than an abstract existence-only wrapper.
Prove genuine history loss: two distinct occurrences with same endpoint prevent any section of endpoint projection from being its left inverse.
Do not assume the chosen path is shortest, canonical, prefix compatible or arrow preserving; a set-theoretic section alone is not a quiver prefunctor, graph embedding or order embedding.
required_controls: One actual Unit loop gives distinct nil/length1 histories with equal endpoint; prove no choice of section can recover both.
Two actual Bool parallel loops give different histories even at equal length and endpoint; retain actual arrow identity.
Actual right inverse succeeds on the reachable subtype; an attempted left-inverse or arbitrary chosen-path monotonicity consumer must fail at its missing premise.
limits: No base connectedness or countability presumed; no full covering/costar identity or universal property.
No automatic source-node prefix representation of arbitrary base reachability; occurrence and vertex identities remain distinct.
